description: ristretto deterministic gates: per-file format after Write/Edit (never blocks — but a formatter that FAILS is reported once, because 'non-blocking' is a promise about exit 2 and not a reason to swallow the output; only inside gates.formatPaths when that is set), full lint+typecheck+test gate on Stop and SubagentStop while a pull is active (blocks with exit 2). SubagentStop gates brew's per-feature subagents individually and is passed the 'subagent' argument, because it is never exempt: while .ristretto/orchestrating exists, Stop is exempt so brew's orchestrator is not gated on a tree its live subagents are mid-edit on. Only one gate run executes at a time repo-wide (.ristretto/gate-lock) — concurrent suites sharing a database or a port invent failures that belong to neither. Hangs are detected by output silence (per-gate budgets in .ristretto.json), not by total runtime, so a slow-but-working suite is never killed. The hook timeouts below are only an outer backstop for the pathological case; they must stay well above any real gate run, or a working suite is killed before it can report. The timeout that actually binds is not here at all: the agent waiting on these hooks is killed after ~10 minutes of silence and loses its result entirely, so the lock wait is sized against what is left of that budget after the last measured run, and a pass that eats half of it says so (see 'watchdog' in .ristretto.json).
